relationships.subject: HDAC2
relationships.evidence_quote: LPS downregulates the expression of α7 nAChR mRNA through histone H3 deacetylation by HDAC2 and HDAC3 in BV2 cells

relationships.subject: TOPK
relationships.evidence_quote: TOPK can bind to HDAC1 and HDAC2, regulate their phosphorylation, and thereby induce their degradation

relationships.subject: HDAC1
relationships.evidence_quote: Nerve injury induced by pSNL in a mouse model results in mechanical allodynia and heat hyperalgesia, accompanied by increased HDAC1 expression in microglia in the ipsilateral superficial dorsal horn

relationships.subject: RGFP966
relationships.evidence_quote: RGFP966 also promotes Sirt1 expression and enhances Nrf2 nuclear accumulation and transcriptional activity

key_findings: Review: class I HDACs (HDAC1, HDAC2, HDAC3) and HDAC6 are upregulated after injury and promote microglial activation and neuropathic pain.
HDAC inhibitors suppress microglial activation and alleviate neuropathic pain in preclinical models.
